name: Bethany Baldes
occupation: Real estate agent; president of the Riverton Chamber of Commerce (as of November 2022)
military: Wyoming Army National Guard (six years, per a WyoFile author biography)
background: Bethany Baldes is a lifelong Riverton resident who ran as the Libertarian nominee for House District 55 in 2022. She lost the Nov. 8, 2022 general election to incumbent Ember Oakley. It was her third race for the seat: WyoFile reported that she lost to then-Rep. David Miller by 53 votes in 2018 and to Oakley by 32 votes in 2020.

A Nov. 4, 2022 WyoFile report said that after serving in the Wyoming National Guard, Baldes was a stay-at-home mother for 11 years, and that she was then working as a real estate agent and serving as president of the Riverton Chamber of Commerce. A WyoFile author biography has also described her as a community activist and mother of three who served six years in the Wyoming Army National Guard and later founded Local Ladies, a social-media outlet highlighting Fremont County businesses.
